sloka: स रोचयामास परैश्च बन्धं प्रसह्य वीरैरभिनिग्रहं च ।कौतूहलान्मां यदि राक्षसेन्द्रो द्रष्ठुं व्यवस्येदिति निश्चितार्थः ।। ५.४८.४८।।।।
transliteration: sa rocayāmāsa paraiśca bandhaṁ prasahya vīrairabhinigrahaṁ ca ।kautūhalānmāṁ yadi rākṣasendro draṣṭhuṁ vyavasyediti niścitārthaḥ ।। 5.48.48।।।।

translations.english: On being bound by bark ropes Hanuman was set free from the bond of Brahmastra, since the bondage of Brahmastra does not tolerate another ordinary bondage.
